questions.solution_html:

  • Ans: A startup is a newly established business venture aimed at solving a
  • specific problem through innovative solutions. Startups are often
  • technology-driven, focused on scalability, and operate in uncertain markets.
  • Their goal is rapid growth and market disruption.
  • Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) are businesses that
  • maintain revenues, assets, or employee counts below a certain threshold
  • defined by national policies.
  • [K] / [CO3]
